name: effective-capacity-is-min-of-chain
when: a facility has an ordered component chain for a service
and: each component carries a nameplate capacity and an approved de-rating factor in DE-RATING REGISTER
then: set effective capacity to the minimum de-rated capacity in the chain and name that component as binding

name: gap-detection
when: forecast load at a facility exceeds effective capacity in a period
and: the forecast and capacity vintages are both locked to the analysis
then: open a gap for the consecutive breach periods, recording peak gap, duration and production at risk

name: severity-scoring
and: magnitude is the peak gap as a share of effective capacity, capped at 20%
duration is breach quarters, capped at 8
proximity falls linearly from the first to the last period of the horizon
then: score severity as 35% magnitude, 30% duration, 35% proximity and band it Low, Medium, High or Critical

name: committed-projects-first
and: a committed project in PROJECT REGISTER adds capacity at the binding component within the horizon
then: credit the committed capacity before proposing any new mitigation, and report the periods in which the breach persists

name: governing-stream-on-transfer
when: a re-routing transfer is being sized
and: the receiving facility has headroom on liquid, gas and water
then: convert each stream headroom to an oil-equivalent transfer using the source GOR and WOR, and let the smallest govern the stream check

name: no-shared-capacity-double-count
when: two or more routes draw on the same receiving facility in the same period
then: allocate receiving headroom to the earliest-breaching gap first and offer only the remainder to the others

name: envelope-release-requires-approval
when: a gap has residual > 0 after re-routing
and: an approved entry exists in ENVELOPE REGISTER for the binding component
the releasable margin is not reserved for another service
then: propose the unreserved margin as an operating-envelope release, before any capital option

name: size-to-live-residual
when: a gap has residual > 0 after operating-envelope release
and: a debottleneck module for the binding component exists in COST REGISTER
then: select the smallest standard module that covers the live residual and carry its Class 5 cost and schedule

name: next-binding-ceiling
when: a mitigation adds capacity at the binding component
and: another component in the chain has lower effective capacity than the new total
then: limit the realised gain to the next-binding component and report the ceiling

name: class-5-flag
when: a cost from COST REGISTER is shown or used in economics
then: label it Class 5 indicative and carry the screening accuracy range with it

name: new-facility-last
when: a gap has residual > 0 after debottlenecking
and: no further module can be added within plot or next-binding limits
then: propose a new facility or train as the last resort

name: route-before-capital
when: a gap has residual > 0 after committed projects
and: a feasible route exists in ROUTING REGISTER with transferable capacity > 0
the receiving facility remains within effective capacity after transfer
then: propose re-routing before any capital option
